segments.title: 第34章 徐有漁的疑惑
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 34: Xu Youyu's Confusion

Early the next morning.

Xu Youyu was sleeping soundly in bed when a knock on the door woke her up.

"Ugh... who is it?" Xu Youyu mumbled irritably, burying her head in her blanket.

"Senior, are you still sleeping?" Ying Chanxi's voice came cautiously from outside. "Li Luo made breakfast, do you want to get up and have some?"

"Hm?" Xu Youyu opened her eyes in a daze. "Breakfast?"

Ever since summer vacation started, she had stayed at home for a few days before her parents got tired of her, so she moved back to her rental. She hadn't eaten breakfast since, sleeping in every day.

She never expected that renting a place would come with a free breakfast service.

She was originally going to refuse.

But when Xu Youyu recalled Li Luo's cooking skills from last night, her mouth began to water.

So, after a great struggle in bed, she said to the door, "I know, I'll be right there."

"Okay," Ying Chanxi said. "I've already finished eating, so I'm heading to school first. I might have to trouble you with the dishes, Senior. I'll do the dishes after dinner."

"Okay, no problem." Xu Youyu wasn't a lazy person; washing a few dishes after eating someone else's breakfast was nothing.

After replying to Ying Chanxi, Xu Youyu struggled in bed for a long while.

As she struggled, she somehow fell asleep again.

When she was woken up again, Xu Youyu heard another voice from outside the room.

Only this time, it wasn't Ying Chanxi, but Li Luo.

"Senior, is it a good time for me to come in?" Li Luo said. "I'll bring your breakfast in so you can eat right in your room."

"Mmm..." Xu Youyu turned over in bed, feeling it was a bit embarrassing to have her junior bring food right to her.

But the thought of having to get up felt like too much trouble.

In the end, laziness won over reason. She answered lazily from under her covers with a nasal hum, "Mhm, you can come in."

The bedroom door opened.

Li Luo was holding a plate. He first walked over to the desk to put it down, then pulled out the chair, moved it to the bedside, and skillfully placed the plate of fried noodles on it, right in front of Xu Youyu's headboard.

After putting down the chopsticks, Li Luo went out of the bedroom again and brought in a glass of water, placing it on the nightstand.

Lying in bed, Xu Youyu watched Li Luo do all of this with such practiced ease, her expression a little dazed.

How does he know I like to eat like this...

Xu Youyu propped herself up and looked down at the fragrant fried noodles, a little embarrassed.

When she was at home, if she couldn't get up for a meal, her mother would bring the food into her room and put it on the desk.

Once her mom left the bedroom, Xu Youyu would put the food on the chair and pull it over to the bed to eat.

That way, she could stay huddled in her blanket while enjoying her meal.

But this was the first time someone had brought her food directly on a chair, right to her... even her mom didn't know she had this habit.

Xu Youyu looked at Li Luo with a hint of suspicion.

Li Luo didn't notice. He just reached out, picked up the two empty beer cans next to the computer, and then said, "Senior, I'll throw these out for you."

"Ah..." Seeing the two empty cans, Xu Youyu's face fell in alarm.

But Li Luo had already walked out of the bedroom, saying as he closed the door, "I'll leave the bowl and chopsticks for you to clean up, kay? Don't forget the ones on the dining table outside either."

With that, Li Luo closed the bedroom door.

Leaving Xu Youyu alone with her mouth slightly agape, her right hand reaching out from under the blanket in a gesture of wanting him to stay.

Wait... Junior... aren't you going to hear my explanation first?

Xu Youyu felt a bit frazzled.

Her secret drinking had been discovered.

But why was her junior's reaction so... unremarkable?

Of course, it wasn't that Xu Youyu was an alcoholic. It was just that when she had writer's block, a little drink helped her inspiration flow.

Gradually, it had become a habit.

Staring at the closed door, Xu Youyu fell silent in bed for a moment before temporarily pushing these matters aside. Like a worm, she wriggled over to the edge of the bed.

Mmm... it smells pretty good.

Xu Youyu leaned towards the plate of fried noodles, picked up the chopsticks, and took a big slurp.

Mmm~

Damn, this is so good?

Xu Youyu blinked, then buried her head again. Her appetite whetted, she was like a little hamster, lost in the temptation of delicious food.

...

Outside, Li Luo stood before the balcony window and stretched in the morning sun.

He had been helping out at his parents' breakfast shop all summer vacation. Now that he could finally relax, he had no idea what to do with himself so early in the morning.

He couldn't just write all day, could he?

After some thought, Li Luo simply went downstairs and jogged a few laps around the residential complex to get some exercise.

In his past life, his weight had skyrocketed after a few years of working, and his knees would hurt just from running.

In this life, while his body was still at its peak, he should exercise more and strive to develop a long-term habit.

When he returned home after his run, Li Luo glanced at the bowls and chopsticks on the living room table, which had already been cleaned up.

It seemed Xu Youyu had finished her breakfast.

Not wanting to disturb her, Li Luo went back to the master bedroom for a shower, then strolled into the northernmost piano room.

Sitting listlessly before the piano, Li Luo placed his ten fingers on the keys. Recalling the memories in his mind, he clumsily played a rendition of "Two Tigers."

He had learned to play the guitar in his past life, but he never learned the piano. He only knew two children's songs and had never played properly.

But just as he was secretly playing the piano to pass the time, the door to the piano room opened, and Xu Youyu's curious head peeked in.

Li Luo turned his head to look at her. "What's wrong? Did I disturb you?"

"No, no," Xu Youyu shook her head and then asked, "You can play the piano, too?"

This junior of hers was a good student, able to get into Fuyi High, score full marks on his essays, cook amazing food, and was even better at writing web novels than she was.

And now he can play the piano, too?

Wasn't that a little too incredible?

Hearing her question, Li Luo immediately shook his head. "I can't, really. I only know 'Two Tigers' and 'Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star'."

"That's still pretty impressive." Xu Youyu breathed a sigh of relief, thinking to herself that it was a good thing he wasn't *that* amazing, or else she would have started feeling insecure.

"But I know a few other things." Li Luo stood up, walked to the corner, and picked up the guitar Ying Zhicheng had brought from Ying Chanxi's home. "I'm pretty decent with this."

As he spoke, Li Luo had already sat down, holding the guitar in his lap and looking at Xu Youyu.

Seeing Li Luo's skillful posture, Xu Youyu raised an eyebrow. "You know how to play this too?"

"Of course." Li Luo smiled, his gaze retracting from Xu Youyu's curvaceous figure. He lowered his head and thought for a moment, then his fingers swept across the strings.

"Once I dreamed of roaming the world with a sword~"

"To see the splendors of the world~"

The moment these two lines were sung, they struck a chord deep within Xu Youyu.

Her breath hitched. Unwilling to even blink, she let the familiar melody and Li Luo's voice swirl in her mind as a question surfaced from the bottom of her heart.

This guy.

He knows how to make her favorite mapo tofu, he's secretly writing entertainment novels just like her, he knows to put her food on a chair and bring it to her bedside, and now, he even knows how to play the guitar.

And what's more.

Why is it that any song he casually sings happens to be her absolute favorite?
